source_title: New Atari Jaguar Release Officially Confirmed for 2027 - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Star Streak is a brand-new 2D arcade shooter set to release on the Atari Jaguar in the first quarter of 2027. The Atari Jaguar home console launched in 1993 and was officially retired in 1996, making Star Streak a rare new release arriving more than 30 years after the console's discontinuation.
Star Streak is developed by Daving Cummings, a solo developer who has worked on the game as a hobby for the past few years. In 2024, Cummings partnered with Songbird Productions to release an early version of Star Streak , limited to 100 cartridges. He has since expanded the game with new content and game modes ahead of its full release on the classic Atari console .
Star Streak, an Asteroids-Like Game Coming to the Atari Jaguar
A new trailer has been released for Star Streak , which is set to launch on the Atari Jaguar in Q1 2027 . The new release will include animated backgrounds, new music, a couple of fresh game modes, and a series of new power-ups and enemies. "Songbird is excited to publish the full version of this 2D arcade shooter," the publisher said without revealing the exact release date or price. The initial physical release of Star Streak was priced at $59.99, which could give fans an idea of how much the full release might cost.

New Features in Star Streak's Full Version
In terms of gameplay, Star Streak is quite similar to one of Atari's most renowned arcade shooters , Asteroids . Players control a fighter spaceship that moves across the screen and must shoot down incoming asteroids and hostile aliens. The main goal is to earn the highest score by keeping the streak going. However, the game also features other modes, including timed missions, in which players try to beat their record in short, three-minute rounds.

Revealing the inspirations behind the game, developer David Cummings said , " Star Streak is a rock-smashing single-screen shooter which takes the concept of Asteroids and Blasteroids to the infamous 64 bits of 2D power." Players can expect a full-fledged arcade experience in Star Streak , with nostalgic sound effects, retro music, and gameplay elements such as power-ups and spaceship boss fights that were staples of top-down sci-fi shooters in the 90s .
The response from retro game enthusiasts has been mostly positive, with many praising Star Streak 's visuals and art direction. The game's initial physical release has also sold out, suggesting there is a market for new games built around the tried-and-true formulas of older titles .
Pre-orders for Star Streak are not open at the time of writing. Players can subscribe to publisher Songbird Productions' newsletter to be notified when the game is released.
